The structure of TmGeSb crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Tm4Ge4Sb4) and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Ge centers 10 neighbors (4 Sb, 6 Tm), Sb centers 9 neighbors (4 Ge, 5 Tm), and Tm centers 15 neighbors (8 Ge, 4 Sb, 3 Tm). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ge and Sb polyhedra, and corner/edge sharing between Ge and Tm polyhedra.
